forecast: Prior-season positional Ridge(alpha=100) with nuisance player form/minutes and own-team attack/defence; venue and separate opponent goals-for/goals-against effects multiplied by prior minutes/90, effect clipped to +/-2. At each future fixture subtract decaying estimated current-match effect and add scheduled fixture effect. Current forecast unchanged.
calendar: Same timestamped snapshots and 14-day fallback as calendar_count_h3; coverage gaps not filled by final schedule
matrix: H3 count,venue,opponent,full; H5/H8 count and full; each fixed_chips and no_chips
chips: Forecast fixed to full, H3 regardless of observed winner. One adaptive type at a time, then all. Prospective candidate versus ordinary path, no realised outcomes used. Reserve constants inherited from opening engine (TC8,others12), decaying toward half-season expiry; lookahead opportunities from frozen-current forecasts. Exact policy locked in chips.py before chip simulations.
limitations: Inherited current fixtures/cutoff and lag-price limitations
Historical player points with newer chips/transfers
Opponent goals rates are not a causal attack/defence decomposition
H5/H8 carry frozen state/prices and do not model future minutes
decision: No automatic benchmark promotion; all seasonal and net results reported.
